fields.summary: Apply a coupon code at checkout
fields.description:
As a shopper I want to apply a coupon code at checkout so that I get a discount.
AC1: Active code SAVE10 reduces the subtotal by 10% and shows 'Coupon applied'.
AC2: Expired code shows 'This coupon has expired'; total unchanged.
AC3: Unknown code shows 'Invalid coupon code'.
AC4: Only one coupon per order -> 'Only one coupon can be applied'.
API: POST /api/cart/{cartId}/coupon {code} -> 200 {code, discount, total}; 400 missing code; 410 expired; 401 unauthenticated; 404 cart not owned.
